item.title: About
item.description:
Experience Link to heading

Junior Penetration Tester based in the UK, currently working client engagements across web application and infrastructure testing. Before moving into offensive security, I spent ~1.8 years as a SOC Analyst, which gave me a solid grounding in detection, triage, and how attacks look from the defender’s side — context I still lean on when testing.

I’m currently working toward OSCP, alongside hands-on project work in web app security and cloud misconfiguration.

item.title: Stay Tuned
item.description:
First real write-up is coming soon — probably starting with a walkthrough of SecureBank, a small banking API I built to actually learn AppSec hands-on, including what happened when I deliberately reintroduced real vulnerabilities and tested whether my own CI security pipeline would catch them.

Until then — the code’s public if you want a preview.
